stock.description: China Tobacco International (HK) Company Limited (CTIHK) is a prominent entity in the international trade of various tobacco products. Its business activities are organized into four distinct divisions: the export and import of tobacco leaf products, and the global distribution of both conventional cigarettes and emerging tobacco items. The Tobacco Leaf Products Export unit is dedicated to sourcing and supplying raw tobacco leaves to cigarette manufacturers and their authorized procurement agents. Conversely, its Tobacco Leaf Products Import division manages the inbound shipment of unprocessed tobacco materials into mainland China. The Cigarettes Export arm focuses on distributing manufactured cigarettes to duty-free retailers and wholesale distributors. Finally, the New Tobacco Products Export segment provides novel tobacco offerings to a diverse client base, including retailers, wholesale cigarette distributors, and other independent third parties. CTIHK boasts a significant international footprint, with operations covering the People's Republic of China, Hong Kong, Indonesia, the Philippines, Vietnam, Singapore, Brazil, and numerous other global markets. Established in 2004, the company's headquarters are located in Kowloon, Hong Kong, and it functions as a subsidiary of China Tobacco International Group Limited.
